description: Source code for ShareViewController, a UIViewController subclass managing the UI and logic of a share extension in an iOS app. It handles extracting shared content (text, URLs, images), composing a message draft, and sending data to an external gateway.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller managing the share extension UI, content extraction, and communication with the external gateway for sharing data.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes UI and sets up view when view loads.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Prepares the draft message when the view appears for the first time.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements such as text view and buttons.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Extracts shared content, composes the draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Triggers sending of the current draft message.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Cancels the share extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Validates and sends the current draft message to the gateway.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Handles network communication to send message and attachments to external gateway.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if a connection retry is needed with a legacy client ID based on error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages to the user on the UI.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a text draft from shared payload data.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up raw text fragments for the draft message.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Extracts shared content items (titles, URLs, text, images) from extension context input items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image attachment from an item provider, converting it to JPEG and encoding in base64.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Determines preferred image type identifier from item provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses UIImage to JPEG respecting max byte size.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL from an item provider, supports string and URL conversions.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text content from an item provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Async helper to load URL value from provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Async helper to load text value from provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Async helper to load raw data from provider.
